fact: A December 2023 presentation by the Centre national des technologies en éducation on the Ministry of Education's digital transformation strategy names Madrassati as the system for the primary stage and EduservPlus as the application for the preparatory and secondary stages, gives public institutions on Madrassati as 4,322 and 4,662 (the pair as extracted, the order of count and total unclear) and states that the rate of uploading pupils' absences at the primary stage is 2 per cent, against 71 per cent in preparatory and secondary schools.
title: استراتيجية وزارة التربية في مجال التحوّل الرقمي
